movers.text: QB Carson Beck (back spasms) did not practice Friday and is questionable at Kansas City; Josh Johnson is expected to start. Gardner Minshew is on IR after UCL surgery.
QB Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) was limited Thursday and Friday and is questionable at Detroit; Todd Bowles said he "looked good" and is trending toward starting. Jalon Daniels is next up.
OL: OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) are out at Chicago; OT Asim Richards (knee) is out multiple weeks. Three line starters missing.
OL: G Trey Smith (concussion) and OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) are out vs. Arizona. RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is also out, targeting the Thursday game at Buffalo.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out; Kirk Cousins starts at San Francisco.

ARI.text: QB Carson Beck (back spasms) did not practice Friday and is questionable at Kansas City; Josh Johnson is expected to start. Gardner Minshew is on IR after UCL surgery.

TB.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) was limited Thursday and Friday and is questionable at Detroit; Todd Bowles said he "looked good" and is trending toward starting. Jalon Daniels is next up.
S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) is out for Sunday at Detroit.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out; Kirk Cousins starts at San Francisco.
WR Jordan Addison had thumb surgery and is out; the Vikings will not place him on IR, per Kevin O'Connell.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist) has no injury designation and LB Blake Cashman (concussion) practiced fully; both are back for San Francisco.

NO.text: OL: OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) are out at Chicago; OT Asim Richards (knee) is out multiple weeks. Three line starters missing.

KC.text: OL: G Trey Smith (concussion) and OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) are out vs. Arizona. RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is also out, targeting the Thursday game at Buffalo.

NYJ.text: QB Geno Smith (ankle) has no injury designation and is set to start at the Chargers after scans came back clean.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) could return Week 16, per ESPN's Dan Graziano. Jacoby Brissett starts at Carolina.
CB Marlon Humphrey is deactivated for Sunday at Carolina (coach's decision); DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) are out.

DET.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) is out for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) is out vs. Tampa Bay. CB D.J. Reed (hip), out the last two games, is questionable.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland and G Tyler Booker (both high-ankle sprains) are out vs. Tennessee.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring), out since Week 3, practiced fully Thursday in his window to return from IR.

BUF.text: CB Christian Benford (groin) and LB Dorian Williams (calf) are out vs. Miami; TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb) is doubtful.

CHI.text: CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is out vs. New Orleans, per the Bears' final injury report.

SF.text: WR Mike Evans is questionable vs. Minnesota; the 49ers say he is "going in the right direction."

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord remains the starter.
S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder/groin) is doubtful at Buffalo; C Aaron Brewer (concussion) is questionable.

PHI.text: Joe Milton starts vs. the Steelers for a second straight game; Tanner McKee is the backup. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out five of six games, will play vs. the Steelers per the final report. LB Zack Baun (back) is ruled out.

CIN.text: G Dalton Risner (knees) did not practice Thursday and G Dylan Fairchild (oblique) is questionable for Monday at Washington. QB Joe Burrow (illness) practiced fully.

JAX.text: C Robert Hainsey (knee) is out for Sunday at the Giants, per Liam Coen.

LV.text: TE Brock Bowers (ankle) is questionable at Denver; he said Friday his availability is still up in the air.

PIT.text: G Mason McCormick (dislocated ankle) was placed on IR Wednesday.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR), out 5 games, practiced fully Thursday and is questionable at Philadelphia.

TEN.text: WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) is on IR and out for the season, per Robert Saleh.
WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), out 2 games, practiced fully Friday and is questionable at Dallas.

DEN.text: S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), out since Week 5, has no game status and is set to return; CB Kris Abrams-Draine practiced fully. S Brandon Jones is questionable.

LAC.text: LB Daiyan Henley (knee) is ruled out vs. the Jets; CB Tarheeb Still (ankle) is questionable.
